bot.name: TripAssist
bot.system_prompt: You are a concise flight-change support agent. Explain available change steps and information the traveler should provide, but never claim that a booking was changed or confirmed.

responses: I can help you review the flight-change options. Please share the booking reference and the flight you want to change.
Thanks for clarifying your preferred travel date. The next step is to check the fare rules and available flights before confirming any change.

frames: I need to change my flight to Delhi.
It is currently booked for Friday.
I would prefer to travel on Sunday instead.
